result:
All questions are now answered with evidence. Here are the results:

## Hard questions

**h01** — S3 presign runner (`s3presign.Runner`) — refreshes presigned URLs for S3-stored attachments every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`, called from `Server.Start` (server/server.go:129; runner created/started at server/server.go:162–171).

**h02** — Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:120 (async path via `PostAsync` and a 4-worker queue, webhook.go:39–55, 184). Protection: the shared `safeClient` uses `safeDialContext`, which resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs at dial time (also defeating DNS rebinding) — internal/webhook/webhook.go:32–37, 59–77, with `isReservedIP` in internal/webhook/validate.go:44 (bypassable only via the `--allow-private-webhooks` flag, cmd/memos/main.go:49,133).

**h03** — Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo`, internal/idp/idp.go:3); implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth2 `IdentityProvider`, internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20).

**h04** — No. The only non-test call to `mysql.NewDB` is inside the factory `NewDBDriver` (store/db/db.go:22); a repo-wide grep for `mysql.NewDB` excluding tests returns exactly that one line, and CodeGraph's call graph shows 1 caller for `NewDB` (store/db/mysql/mysql.go:20).

**h05** — Explicit Go code, inside the driver's DeleteUser transaction: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (reactions on the user's memos) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (reactions the user made) — store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96,102 (helpers at :380–388 and :400–403; identical in mysql/postgres user_delete.go). Not a DB rule: SQLite is opened with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)` (store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53), so no cascading constraints apply.

**h06** — Handlers: `CreateMemo` (server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157), `UpdateMemo` (memo_service.go:513 → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`, memo_update_helpers.go:67), `DeleteMemo` (memo_service.go:562), `CreateMemoComment` (memo_service_comments.go:119), also `SetMemoAttachments` (memo_attachment_service.go:48) and `SetMemoRelations` (memo_relation_service.go:48). Convergence function: `webhook.Post` — internal/webhook/webhook.go:120 (all dispatchers funnel through `webhook.PostAsync` → queue → `Post`).

**h07** —
- Route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168 (anonymous-access gate at :173–181)
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715
- `Store.GetUser` (userCache check, then list) — store/user.go:148
- `Store.ListUsers` → `driver.ListUsers` — store/user.go:136–137
- concrete driver e.g. `(*sqlite.DB).ListUsers` — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88
- avatar data-URI parsed and served from `user.AvatarURL` — fileserver.go:196–209

**h08** —
- `s3presign.Runner` (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43) — invoked: yes — callers `Server.startBackgroundRunners` (server/server.go:163) and `s3presign.Runner.Run` (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36)
- `memopayload.Runner` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27) — not invoked from production — `memopayload.NewRunner` has zero non-test callers (grep across repo); only the package-level function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used by production code (memo_service.go:108,447)

**h09** — Count: 6 hand-written backend declarations (excluding generated code/frontend): `(*sqlite.DB).Close` store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67, `(*mysql.DB).Close` store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47, `(*postgres.DB).Close` store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46, `(*store.Store).Close` store/store.go:72, `(*cache.Cache).Close` store/cache/cache.go:187, `(*apiv1.SSEHub).Close` server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99. Invoked by non-test server code: `Store.Close` ← server/server.go:146; `Cache.Close` ← store/store.go:74–76; the driver `DB.Close` (sqlite/mysql/postgres, via `Driver` interface dispatch) ← store/store.go:78; `SSEHub.Close` ← server/server.go:206.

**h10** — `filter.DefaultEngine` — internal/filter/engine.go:111 — ~7 non-test callers (memo/memo_relation list code in all three DB drivers plus shortcut_service.go:341); tied at ~7 with `util.GenUUID` (internal/util/util.go:40). No other function/method under internal/ exceeds this (next: `filter.AppendConditions` and `Engine.CompileToStatement` at 6).

**h11** — 1st: `store.User` — referenced from ~5 non-test packages outside the store layer (server/auth, server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/fileserver, server/router/rss); 2nd: `store.Memo` — ~4 packages (server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/rss, server/runner/memopayload).

**h12** — Concrete method: `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16. Determination: with no flags, `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` / flag default "sqlite" (cmd/memos/main.go:122,130) makes `profile.Driver == "sqlite"`, so the factory switch selects `sqlite.NewDB` (store/db/db.go:18–20); `Store` methods dispatch through the `store.Driver` interface (store/memo.go:113) to that instance.

**h13** — Impl: unexported `service` struct wrapping goldmark — internal/markdown/markdown.go:58, implementing the `markdown.Service` interface (markdown.go:31); the only runtime implementation. Construction: `markdown.NewService(...)` in `NewAPIV1Service` — server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48. Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (v1.go:35), `rss.RSSService.MarkdownService` (server/router/rss/rss.go:45, injected at server/server.go:85), and `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16).

**h14** — Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74–88, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` (internal/markdown/markdown.go:356–422) and stores the result in `memo.Payload`. Triggers: memo creation (`CreateMemo`, server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108), memo content update (`UpdateMemo`, memo_service.go:447), and the batch rebuild `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (runner.go:27, not wired into startup). Extracted: tags, and `Property` booleans/fields — title (leading H1), `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` (markdown.go:383–408).

**h15** —
- gRPC memo read check (`GetMemo` path): PRIVATE/PROTECTED gate — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:55–63
- gRPC memo listing: visibility filter injected into the query — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219–226
- HTTP attachment file serving: `checkAttachmentPermission` on the owning memo — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:677–699
- gRPC attachment binary access — server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445–451
- Reactions on memos — server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30–38,83
- Memo comments — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41
- RSS feeds: PUBLIC-only — server/router/rss/rss.go:90,141
- User stats: visibility-restricted listing — server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84–90
- Frontend sitemap/SEO: PUBLIC-only — server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150

## Reality-check questions

**r01** — False premise: there is no Redis anywhere in the codebase (repo-wide grep for "redis" in Go code returns nothing). The cache is an in-process, in-memory `sync.Map`-based cache (`store/cache/cache.go:67`), configured in `store.New` with `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`, cleanup every 5 minutes, max 1000 items (store/store.go:40–45); user entries go into `userCache` with that 10-minute default TTL (store/store.go:52, store/user.go:98).

**r02** — False premise: no per-user (or any) API rate-limiting middleware exists — grep for rate-limit across server/internal/cmd finds nothing. The only Echo middleware registered is `Recover` and CORS (server/server.go:51–52).

**r03** — False premise: no nightly database-cleanup job exists. A generic cron scheduler package exists (internal/scheduler/scheduler.go) but is imported only by its own tests — no production code registers any job. The only scheduled background work is the S3 presign runner on a 12-hour ticker (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27), not a database cleanup and not cron-time-based.

**r04** — False premise: neither NATS nor RabbitMQ (nor any broker) is used — grep for nats/rabbitmq/amqp returns nothing. Webhook delivery uses an in-process buffered Go channel `asyncPostQueue` (capacity 128, internal/webhook/webhook.go:39) drained by 4 goroutine workers started in `init()` (webhook.go:42–55) that POST directly over HTTP via `webhook.Post` (webhook.go:120).

**r05** — False premise: there is no GraphQL schema or endpoint (repo-wide grep for "graphql" returns nothing). The public API surface is gRPC services defined in protobuf under proto/api/v1/*.proto, exposed over HTTP via gRPC-Gateway registered as API v1 (`apiV1Service.RegisterGateway`, server/server.go:88) plus Connect handlers (server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go), alongside RSS (server/router/rss/rss.go) and MCP (server/router/mcp) routes.
